mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_order_profitsharing (id, order_id, rule_id, amount_fee, payment_rate, payment_fee, tax_rate, tax_fee, system_income, driver_income, `status`) VALUES (#{id}, #{orderId}, #{ruleId}, #{amountFee}, #{paymentRate}, #{paymentFee}, #{taxRate}, #{taxFee}, #{systemIncome}, #{driverIncome}, 1)
mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS profitsharingId, CAST(driver_income AS CHAR) AS driverIncome FROM tb_order_profitsharing p JOIN tb_order o ON p.order_id = o.id WHERE o.uuid = #{uuid};

SELECT p.id AS profitsharingId, CAST(p.id AS CHAR) AS outOrderNo, o.pay_id AS transactionId FROM tb_order_profitsharing p JOIN tb_order o ON p.order_id = o.id WHERE p.`status` = 1 AND o.pay_time <= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{minute} MINUTE) LIMIT 100
